aboutPage.metaDescription: Blackline Concierge — Miami luxury coordination with chauffeur ground transport at the core: professional drivers, Maybach vans, SUVs, and executive vehicles. Plus yachts, jets, villas, and VIP nightlife.
aboutPage.headline: Miami luxury, coordinated end to end.
aboutPage.heroBodyBefore: Blackline Concierge is a Miami-based team that plans and runs high-touch trips.
aboutPage.heroBodyHighlight: Chauffeur-driven ground transport is at the center of how we operate
aboutPage.heroBodyAfter: — airport runs, nights out, and multi-stop days — layered with yachts, stays, aviation, and VIP access when you want the full arc.
aboutPage.storyP1: Visitors come to Miami for the cars, the yachts, the villas, and the nights out — but pulling it together usually means juggling separate contacts, timing, and last-minute changes. We built Blackline around the opposite idea:
aboutPage.storyP1Highlight: one trusted team that speaks to everyone on your behalf
aboutPage.storyP1After: , keeps the plan coherent, and adjusts when your group does.
aboutPage.storyP2Highlight: chauffeur services are the backbone of what we do
aboutPage.storyP2After: : professional drivers, curated vehicles from executive SUVs and Mercedes-Maybach vans to high-spec sedans and VIP vans — timed to your flights, reservations, and dockside pickups. When the ground leg is locked in, everything else — yachts, villas, jets, clubs — snaps into place around it.
aboutPage.storyP3: Whether you need a self-drive exotic, a crewed charter, a private residence, aviation, or a table when the room is hard to book, we route requests through a single line — text or call — so you always know who is handling what.
aboutPage.chauffeurHeadline: Ground transport at the heart of the itinerary
aboutPage.chauffeurP1Before: Most trips don't start on a yacht — they start at the airport, the hotel, or a curb downtown.
aboutPage.chauffeurP1Highlight: Our chauffeur desk is where Blackline spends the most focused energy day to day:
aboutPage.chauffeurP1After: pairing your group with the right vehicle class, driver, and timing so every leg feels effortless.
aboutPage.chauffeurP2: From Mercedes-Maybach vans and executive SUVs to Rolls-Royce and curated sedans, each booking is matched to the occasion — airport transfers (MIA / FLL / OPF), multi-stop nights out, event arrivals, and dockside yacht pickups — always with the same discreet, professional standard.
aboutPage.chauffeurBullet1: Scheduled pickups aligned with flights and reservation times — not generic "window" quotes that slip.
aboutPage.chauffeurBullet2: Fleet breadth for solo travelers through large VIP groups — one team coordinating vehicles across your whole stay.
aboutPage.chauffeurBullet3: Natural handoff to yachts, villas, and nightlife when you want the full Miami arc — same concierge thread start to finish.
aboutPage.chauffeurImageAlt: VIP chauffeur sprinter — executive group transport
aboutPage.servicesBody: Chauffeur ground transport ties everything together — start there or browse each offering in detail. Tell us your occasion and we'll propose the right mix.
aboutPage.principle1Body: Ground, water, air, and nights out — we route everything through a single concierge thread so you are not chasing five different vendors mid-trip.
aboutPage.principle2Body: Share when you land, how many guests, and what matters most. We shape the itinerary and swap elements until it fits — nothing is one-size-fits-all.
aboutPage.principle3Body: From chauffeured transfers to table reservations, we keep coordination tight and professional — so you can focus on the experience, not the logistics.
aboutPage.miamiHeadline: Rooted in the city we operate in
aboutPage.miamiBody: We focus on Miami and South Florida — the marinas, airports, venues, and seasonal rhythms — so routing, timing, and backup plans reflect how the city actually moves. When plans shift, we're already thinking about the next best option on the ground.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Share your dates and what you want to experience — we'll reply with next steps and a tailored outline.
